item.title: 📍 Cargo must arrive on time Dnepropetrovsk direction Servicemen of the supply groups of the Tsentr Group of Forces cover over 100 kilometres a day
item.description: Cargo must arrive on time 📍 Dnepropetrovsk direction 🚛 Servicemen of the supply groups of the Tsentr Group of Forces cover over 100 kilometres a day in Dnepropetrovsk direction. Every tour to the front line takes place under the sights of enemy drones. ▫️ The enemy hides 'awaiter' ambush drones along the roads and also attacks the convoys with fixed-wing strike drones. 💥 To break through, the crews continuously scan the sky . Upon spotting an 'awaiter' drone or an incoming attack drone, gunners immediately open heavy fire and shoot down the targets on approach. 🤝 Thanks to the composure of the drivers and the marksmanship of the gunners, the cargo reaches the front line right on schedule. 🔹 Russian Defence Ministry
item.content:encoded:

Cargo must arrive on time
📍
Dnepropetrovsk direction
🚛
Servicemen of the supply groups of the Tsentr Group of Forces cover over 100 kilometres a day
in Dnepropetrovsk direction. Every tour to the front line takes place under the sights of enemy drones.
▫️
The enemy hides 'awaiter' ambush drones along the roads and also attacks the convoys with fixed-wing strike drones.
💥
To break through,
the crews continuously scan the sky
. Upon spotting an 'awaiter' drone or an incoming attack drone, gunners immediately open heavy fire and shoot down the targets on approach.
🤝
Thanks to the composure of the drivers and the marksmanship of the gunners,
the cargo reaches the front line right on schedule.
🔹
Russian Defence Ministry

item.title: ▫️ Pulse under control Servicemen in the special military zone hone their skills on a special psychological obstacle course.
item.description: Pulse under control ▫️ ▫️ Servicemen in the special military zone hone their skills on a special psychological obstacle course. On this route, not only physical endurance is important, but also the ability to think clearly under intense pressure. ➡️ The course is designed to put maximum strain on the psyche , featuring constant noise and distractions. 🤝 Exercises are performed in pairs. Freshmen are paired with experienced stormtroopers—this helps them adapt faster and build teamwork. 🔹 Russian Defence Ministry

item.title: 🎖 by Russian Defence Ministry on progress of special military operation as of 22 November 2026
item.description: 🎖 🎖 by Russian Defence Ministry on progress of special military operation as of 22 November 2026 Part 2 ( 👉 see Part 1 ) ↗️ The Vostok Group of Forces continued to advance into the depths of the enemy's defence. Russian troops inflicted losses on manpower and hardware of four air assault brigades, two assault brigades, and an assault regiment of the AFU near Mayak, Tikhoye, Prosyanaya, Malomikhailovka (Dnepropetrovsk region), Yasnaya Polyana, Odarovka, and Veseloye (Zaporozhye region). ▪️ The AFU losses amounted to up to 220 troops, one armoured fighting vehicle, six motor vehicles, one U.S.-made 155-mm M777 howitzer, and one electronic warfare station. 📍 The Dnepr Group's units improved the situation along the front line. The Group's elements hit formations of three mechanised brigades and a mountain assault brigade of the AFU near Dimitrovo of Zaporozhye region, Belozerka, and Mikhaylovka of Kherson region. ▪️ Up to 20 troops, 24 motor vehicles, one 155-mm Bogdana howitzer, and one counter-fire radar station of the were neutralised. ✈️ Operational-Tactical Aviation, attack drones, missile troops, and artillery of the Russian Groups of Forces destroyed a missile launcher of a Neptune coastal missile system, hit energy and transport infrastructure facilities used in the interests of the AFU, production areas, storage areas of unmanned aerial vehicles and launch areas, as well as temporary deployment areas of Ukrainian armed formations and foreign mercenaries in 144 areas. ▫️

item.content:encoded:

The Armed Forces of the Russian Federation continue the special military operation.
🚩
As a result of intensive actions, units of the Sever Group of Forces gained control over the settlement of Sosnovy Bor in Kharkov region.
💥
Russian troops engaged
manpower and hardware of two mechanised brigades, an assault regiment of the AFU, and two territorial defence brigades close to Novoselovka, Khatneye, Ploskoye, Rubezhnoye, Podsredneye, and Fedorovka in Kharkov region.
🔥
In Sumy region,
the Group's units
inflicted losses on
formations of a mechanised brigade, two airmobile brigades of the AFU, and two territorial defence brigades near Khoten, Radkovka, Pushkarevka, Krasnopolye, Stepanovka, and Spasskoye (Sumy region).
▪️
The enemy lost over 120 troops, three motor vehicles, and one electronic warfare station.
↗️
The Zapad Group of Forces improved the situation along the front line.
Russian troops hit manpower and hardware of four mechanised brigades, an airmobile brigade of the AFU, a marine brigade, and two territorial defence brigades close to Khomino, Chervony Oskol, Gusinka, Staroverovka, and Peski-Radkovskiye of Kharkov region.
▪️
The AFU losses amounted to up to 210 troops and 10 motor vehicles.
📍
The Yuzhnaya Group of Forces took more advantageous lines and positions.
The Group's elements engaged formations of four mechanised brigades, a motorised infantry brigade, two airmobile brigades, and an assault regiment of the AFU near Kramatorsk, Druzhkovka, Slavyansk, Belenkoye, Raygorodok, Novoselovka, and Nikolayevka of the Donetsk People's Republic.
▪️
The AFU losses amounted to up to 145 troops, one armoured personnel carrier, one Kazak armoured fighting vehicle, 21 motor vehicles, and one 155-mm Bogdana howitzer.
↗️
The Tsentr Group's units continued to carry out active offensive operations.
The Group's units inflicted losses on manpower and hardware of two mechanised brigades, a jaeger brigade of the AFU, two marine brigades, four national guard brigades, and the Azov special forces brigade close to Rayskoye, Privolye, Novokrivorozhye, Andreyevka, Sergeyevka, Novodonetskoye, Stepanovka, Lvovka, Kuroyedovka, and Kamenka in the Donetsk People's Republic.
▪️
The AFU losses amounted to up to 345 troops, seven armoured fighting vehicles, eight motor vehicles, one artillery gun, and one electronic warfare station.
👉
See
Part 2
🔹
Russian Defence Ministry
